title: Conditional κ = 0.001635877117861902: owner repair on PR627 factored ends
body:
Raises conditional **κ to 0.001635877117861902**, exactly `817938558930951/500000000000000000`, by repairing the owner map on PR627. The gain over pinned PR627 is `0.000000127279804738`; the conservative rate is `0.001635877114991649`.

The two supplier words, recipes, 64 JP8 / 8 CK dispatch, and all verifier code are byte-identical to PR627 (`f95308a9afa5adc071fe75c8cd7feec172503d4f`). The change is 18,250 literal owner placements. The idle profile becomes `{1:44,2:1,3:2,12:1,16:3,32:2,48:2220}`; rank mass 520704, live 7168, physical 7670 and 35424 hosted roles are unchanged. A bounded three-bin DP search nominated the map; the complete invoice and strict exact engines certify the combined result. No optimality claim.

The standalone package vendors all six pinned sources. Its wrapper rebuilds every provider and baseline, checks arbitrary inputs, reflected ledgers, wrappers, all phases, physical ownership, the finite invoice, both moment engines and outer inequalities. A separate checker reads the actual native programs, checks every placement, and recomputes strict moments with independent rational log/exp intervals. A deterministic exporter reproduces the submitted map from pinned PR627 inputs.

Validation includes complete fresh macOS and Linux replays, 64 successful stages per platform, all 51 receipt artifacts and every stage log, 23 owner mutations and 114 assembly controls. Supplemental declaration/map checkers pass two positive and eight rejection controls under isolated optimized Python. Full evidence, source comparisons and search provenance accompany the package. Earlier exploratory admission explicitly reused our fresh PR627 baseline/native receipts; the final platform replays do not.

The inherited compiler, common-label/mutable-source realization, whole-call hosting, precision/tape/exact recovery and analytic-transfer assumptions remain. The cited PR543 bit supplier is repriced, not rebuilt; its surcharge and H1–H5 remain. No unconditional multiplication theorem, full Lean proof or practical speed claim.

Credits: Jeremy Diviney for PR627's unchanged factored cold ends; PR622/623/626 and all predecessor credits remain in NOTICE. The owner repair, packaging and independent validation were prepared with OpenAI Codex for chafreaky. A Python 3.11/3.14 workflow runs the full wrapper.
